shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100 && cat package.json AGENTS.md

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C 4 'markdown-editor\|md-editor\|wysiwyg' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

sed -n 360,370p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'
npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -60
npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor peerDependenciesMeta --json
npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components @diplodoc/transform katex markdown-it@^13 @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15
for v in 4.24.0 4.23.0 4.22.0 4.21.0 4.20.0; do echo "$v: $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies --json | tr -d '\n ')"; done

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.0 @diplodoc/transform katex markdown-it@^13 @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension 2>&1 | tail -15 && grep -A14 '"dependencies"' package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json

sed -i 's/"@gravity-ui\/components": "\^4.23.0"/"@gravity-ui\/components": "4.23.0"/' package.json && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor useMarkdownEditor MarkdownEditorView 2>&1 | head -60
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor useMarkdownEditor MarkdownEditorView 2>&1 | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; ls build/docs
ls build/docs/guides; grep -rn -i "styles\|css\|initial\|'change'\|preset\|toolbarsPreset\|md:\|wysiwygConfig" build/docs/guides | head -60
sed -n 1,80p build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; ls build; ls build/esm | head; find build -name 'useMarkdownEditor*.d.ts' -o -name 'types.d.ts' -path '*bundle*' | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle && cat useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; grep -n "initial\|preset\|md\?:\|mode\|handlers\|wysiwygConfig\|markupConfig" types.d.ts | head -50; grep -rn "export type MarkdownEditorViewProps\|interface MarkdownEditorViewProps" -A 40 MarkdownEditorView.d.ts | head -60; grep -rln "\.css" ../index.js ../bundle/*.js | head

sed -n 1,60p MarkdownEditorView.d.ts | head -20; sed -n 20,50p types.d.ts; sed -n 160,190p types.d.ts; grep -n "MarkdownEditorMode\b\|MarkdownEditorPreset\b\|placeholder" preset-base-types.d.ts | head; grep -n "on(\|'change'\|change:\|getValue\|clear\|replace" editor-public-types.d.ts ../common/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -n "EventMap\|change\|submit\|cancel" Editor.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "MarkdownEditorWysiwygConfig =" -A 25 types.d.ts | grep -n "placeholder\|escapeConfig\|extensions" ; grep -n "MarkdownEditorMarkupConfig =" -A 30 types.d.ts | grep -i "placeholder\|splitMode"; sed -n 1,25p preset-base-types.d.ts
cat events.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "configure" ../configure.d.ts; grep -n "export" ../index.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/configure.d.ts; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Button Card configure 2>&1 | head -30; grep -n "errorMessage\|validationState\|label?\|note" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -rn "export declare const configure\|export declare function configure" --include=*.d.ts . | head -3; grep -n "view?\|type?\|theme?" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head

sed -n 1,20p utils/configure.d.ts; grep -n "whiteSpace\|wordBreak\|color?" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head; grep -o '"code-[0-9a-z-]*"' components/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u; grep -rho "'code-[0-9]'" components/Text/ | sort -u
cat components/Text/Text.d.ts | sed -n 1,40p | grep -n "?:"; grep -n "?:" components/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rn "whiteSpace\|wordBreak" components/Text/ --include=*.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "export declare const sp\b\|export declare const sp:\|sp =\|export { spacing\|sp," node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/spacing/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import {configure as configureUikit, Button, Card, Flex, Text, TextInput} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';","import {configure as configureUikit, Button, Card, Flex, Text, TextInput, sp} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';")
s=s.replace("<Flex direction=\"column\" gap={6} style={{maxWidth: 800, margin: '0 auto', padding: 24}}>","<Flex direction=\"column\" gap={6} className={sp({p: 6})} style={{maxWidth: 800, marginInline: 'auto'}}>")
s=s.replace("<Card view=\"outlined\" style={{padding: 'var(--g-spacing-4)'}}>","<Card view=\"outlined\" className={sp({p: 4})}>")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -E "built in|error" ; git status --short
cat .gitignore; rm -rf dist
